extracted_content.title: Overview
extracted_content.content: Electronic claim submission, reimbursement and electronic remittance advice (ERA) transactions are less costly than paper-based transactions for both providers and payers. The majority of payer reimbursement to providers in the United States are conducted using electronic means, and the healthcare industry continues to move toward the elimination of paper transactions.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage and Medicaid Payment Policy
extracted_content.subsection: Medicare Advantage and Medicaid Payment Policy
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: References > Medicare Advantage and Medicaid Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Humana encourages electronic transactions for claim submission, reimbursement and explanation of remittance advice.
